generic_shared_controller.scope: Fixed fresh8stream natural full-history candidate screen. Generic shared latents do not implement explicit semantic constraints. Does not erase previous failed comparisons or establish an architecture contribution.

metrics.interpretation: All prior failed shared/history/repeat primaries stay failed. Prior canonical necessity and same-profile oracle sufficiency stay recorded as passed on the reused development cohort. Oracle evidence addresses are program-supplied and can simplify reasoning; neither oracle success nor record-deletion failure proves GDN information loss or the superiority of a new block.
